**An insanely secure & private thinking partner, living at home.** Estia runs on one Mac at home and is reached only through Signal: encrypted texts, voice notes and calls.

## What changed in {{VERSION}}

{{SECTION}}

## What is in 0.9

- **Core, works once setup is done:** chat, memory in two parts (yours in every message, notes from your chats when they matter), reminders, language practice in eight languages (`/babble`), saved lists, the Mac's health, photos (deleted after the first answer), YouTube summaries from captions, and an emergency stop (`/lock`).
- **Opt-in, off until turned on:** messages she starts (at most one a day, never between 22:00 and 08:00) and a three-question evening note written by the code.
- **Extras, each off until set up:** calls that can be interrupted, wake-up calls, voice notes transcribed on the Mac, calendars (read-only), Microsoft 365 mail (read-only), the 09:15 morning digest, Spotify, Kasa and Philips Hue lights, web search, chords, transposing chords, Google places and routes, projects on the Mac, and answers from your PDFs that name the document and the page.
- **Two built-in styles:** hearth or playful, picked at setup. Name her what you like; her Signal picture is her name's first letter with Estia's orange full stop.
